2000F: Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray with Cor-Flex
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-2000xf-the-rock-flexible-insulated-food-tray-with-cor-flex
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/the-rock-tray-with-cor-flex/
Spec sheet: 2000F
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray with Cor-Flex – 2000F
Current H1: Cortech The Rock Flexible Insulated Food Tray
Subtitle: Seamless One-Piece Insulated Meal Tray Made of Pliable Cor-Flex Material
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 2000CF, 2000DGF, 2000TCF, 2000OF The Rock Flexible Insulated Food Tray with Cor-Flex
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray with Cor-Flex is the Rock Tray made of pliable Cor-Flex material, for prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It has five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments, and it stacks with or without lids.
The tray is a true one-piece, seamless design that keeps water out, made with FDA-approved material. It has the same size and compartments as the Rock Tray, and it uses its own Cor-Flex lids.
Material: One-piece, seamless Cor-Flex tray made with FDA-approved material; does not absorb water
Compartments: Five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments
Dimensions: 14¼”L×9½”W×1¾”H; food compartments are 1¼” deep
Weight: 2 lbs per tray
Corners: Radius corners and a softly beveled bottom make it easier to eat from and to clean
Stacking: Stacks with or without lids
Care: Do not use bleach on the trays
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Warranty: 5-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
2000CF – Brown: Rock Tray with Cor-Flex
2000DGF – Dark Gray: Rock Tray with Cor-Flex
2000TCF – Terracotta: Rock Tray with Cor-Flex
2000OF – Orange: Rock Tray with Cor-Flex
Lids: Matching Cor-Flex lids sold separately
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Rock with Cor-Flex suits facilities that want the Rock Tray in a pliable material.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (57 characters): Cortech Rock Food Tray with Cor-Flex - 2000F at Anchortex
Meta description (158 characters): Shop the Cortech Rock Tray with Cor-Flex. A seamless one-piece insulated meal tray of pliable Cor-Flex material with five food and two condiment compartments.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it The Rock Tray with Cor~Flex, and its web page uses the SKU 2000F. I used "Rock Insulated Food Tray with Cor-Flex" with 2000F at the end, and wrote "Cor-Flex" with a hyphen, as on your current page.
Warranty: your current page says 2-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 5-year factory warranty, so I used that.
Material: the Cortech spec sheet calls Cor-Flex a "pliable" material but also says "high impact, no break, polypropylene" in the same sheet. I used "Cor-Flex" only.
Compartment depth: your current page says 2.25” deep. The Cortech spec sheet says the tray is 1.75” high and uses 1.25” from top to bottom of the feeding surface, so I used those.
Cart capacity: the Cortech web page for this tray gives the Rock 2.0 cart numbers (120 in the Chuckwagon), not the Rock numbers (150), so I left cart capacity out.
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown," "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terracotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "2000CF - Brown"?
Weight: your variants are set to 20 lbs, which matches a case of 10 at 2 lbs per tray.
Case pricing: Cortech sells the trays in cases of 10. Your current pages do not say whether the price is per tray or per case. I wrote "Sold in cases of 10." Is your price per case?
Bleach: the Cortech spec sheet says "Do not use bleach on food trays," so I added it as a Care bullet.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has the same tray photo. I did not find other photos.
